## SK Hynix Labor and Management Approach Final Wage Deal as Stock Bonus Debate Intensifies

Labor cost resolution at the world's leading HBM manufacturer is a margin watch item; a stock-bonus outcome could also affect dilution at a name already carrying a significant AI-cycle premium.

- SK Hynix's labor and management sides are pressing toward a final wage agreement.
- The stock bonus component of negotiations is described as a continuing point of contention.
- No settlement terms, figures, or timeline are confirmed in the headline.
- As the dominant HBM supplier, any labor cost outcome carries margin implications for SK Hynix.
